title: A typed provider failure kind is lost when a Stop defers the turn's terminal callback, so the later pause reads unclassified
outcome: A typed provider failure kind is lost when a Stop defers the turn's terminal callback, so the later pause reads unclassified
acceptance: When a Stop is in progress as a turn's typed provider failure arrives (Claude api_error_status or Codex codexErrorInfo), and the Stop fails and replays that turn's deferred terminal callback, the resulting pause carries the provider's typed failure kind rather than unclassified; a behaviour test drives that replay.
